name: Ball Block
author: madisondsmith90
description: Controls: a, w, d, s; shift+w for sprint.                                                              My first game made from scratch using Unity. This project offered many valuable lesson. One of which was creating game objects within unity such as the tree and ramp for the marble. The other, most satisfying part of this project was utilizing a C# script to allow user input to dictate the capsule's movement. Now block that ball!
